samples.reason: This is an educational physics explanation task — closest to extraction/retrieval and clear technical reasoning, where Petrel holds a slight edge (GPQA 64.8, MMLU-Pro 80.9). No harm-adjacent content, neutral-to-friendly tone, so neither model's aversions apply.

This is an educational physics explanation task with substantial extraction/explanatory demands. Petrel leads slightly on the relevant capability axes (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval) and the task carries no harm or tone factors that would trigger its aversions. Both models are near-tied on creative/explanatory work, so the marginal STEM-reasoning edge decides it.
